item.title: From an Exposed iLO to Persistent Root via CVE-2017-12542
item.description: In this blog, I walk through how a single unpatched out-of-band management interface (HP iLO 4) let me take full control of a physical server — from one unauthenticated request to a pre-OS root shell and a permanent SSH backdoor — without ever knowing an operating-system credential.
